text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks B, E and D for gains felt rewarding, but my cost basis is not a sound reason to sell; I should decide based on each holding’s prospective risk and return.","I held through substantial account declines without reassessing, then bought B, D and E again. I should review positions against a consistent plan rather than let loss aversion or a lower price dictate my choices.","A few periods of price history do not predict future moves. I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and trade only when my objectives, risk limits or portfolio plan warrant it."]}
